changelog: Turn a TikTok hashtag trend into one talking hook clip per still.

en.description: Turn a TikTok hashtag trend into one talking hook clip per still. This TikTok hashtag hook studio reads public hashtag rankings and head posts, then records each already-written hook as a 2 to 15s talking clip. Those TikTok hashtag hooks become a short trend hook video, and each hashtag hook clip stays a file they can send on its own.
en.summary: Turn a TikTok hashtag trend into one talking hook clip per still.
en.title: TikTok Hashtag Hook Clips: One Still, One Trend Hook
